question: Should exported Claw packages standardize on YAML-frontmatter `CLAW.md` as the canonical representation while retaining JSON as a readable compatibility input?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but choosing the canonical package representation creates a durable authoring, tooling, documentation, and upgrade contract that code review cannot approve implicitly.

options.title: Adopt after stack approval
options.body: Approve `CLAW.md` as canonical after the RFC and prerequisite lifecycle slices are accepted, then land this PR in stack order.

options.title: Keep JSON canonical
options.body: Retain JSON as the exported representation and narrow this PR to optional `CLAW.md` input support.

options.title: Continue incubation
options.body: Keep this slice open while the RFC and lifecycle implementation provide more compatibility and tooling evidence.
